info.title: Lydie API
info.description: Generated from @lydie/contract. Pin a version with the `Lydie-Version` header (YYYY-MM-DD). Errors use the `{error:{code,message,hint}}` envelope.

get.summary: List where you are signed in
get.description: Your live sessions, most recently active first.

post.description: Ends every session except this one.

delete.description: Ends one of your other sessions. To end this one, sign out.
The token stops working at once.

post.description: Records an attachment whose bytes are already stored under their SHA-256 (the Blob port locally, an upload URL when hosted). Several attachments may share the same bytes.

post.summary: Get an upload URL for a file
post.description: Checks access and limits and returns a signed URL (15 minutes) to PUT the file's bytes to. `upload` is null when the same bytes are already stored. Then record the file with attachment.create. Needs edit access to the document (or membership for workspace files).

delete.description: Moves an attachment to the trash. Restore it with attachment.restore.

get.summary: Get a download URL for an attachment
get.description: A signed URL valid for an hour, usable without a session (e.g. in ).

post.description: Permanently deletes an attachment in the trash. Its bytes are removed when no other attachment uses them. Cannot be undone.

get.summary: Get a download link for a backup
get.description: A signed link to the backup's zip, valid for 15 minutes.
Owners and admins only.

patch.description: Renames a connection, changes its settings or replaces its credentials (checked with the destination first). Owners and admins only.

delete.description: Removes a connection and its stored credentials. Refused while publications use it, unless `force` (they are removed too; what they published stays at the destination). Owners and admins only.

post.description: Checks the stored credentials with the destination and records the result. Owners and admins only.

get.description: Destinations documents can be published to, with their auth methods, the settings a connection needs and the config a publication takes (JSON Schema), and what they can do.

patch.description: Replaces the property's configuration and/or its key. A new key moves every row's value to it (one undo step).

delete.description: Moves the property to the trash. Row values stay in the documents' properties, so restoring it brings them back. Deleting one side of a two-way relation makes the other side one-way.

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key (recorded so replays converge).

post.description: Changes the display name only; the frontmatter key and row values stay (use database.updateProperty with key to rename the key).
Changes the type and converts every row's value (see the conversion table in the docs). convert: false keeps the values as they are.

patch.summary: Rename or recolour a select option
patch.description: Rows store the option's name, so renaming rewrites the rows that use it (one undo step).

delete.description: Removes the option and clears it from every row that uses it (one undo step).

post.description: Places a row after/before another (the manual order every unsorted view shows) and, with group/subGroup and a grouped viewId, moves it to that group by setting the grouped property.

fromGroup.description: The group it was in (list-valued groups).

patch.description: Changes the view's type and/or replaces the given top-level config fields (filter, sorts, groupBy, subGroupBy, columns, limit, summaries, layout); fields not given stay.

post.description: Copies a view right after itself. The name defaults to “<name> copy”.
The first view opens by default (and is what a plain embed shows).

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key (recorded so replays converge).

post.description: Creates a database: a document whose children are its rows. With documentId, turns an existing document into a database (its children become rows). Starts with a title property and one view.

id.description: Client-minted id of the new database document.

documentId.description: Turn this existing document into a database.

teamspaceId.description: Hosted: the teamspace a new top-level database goes into (null or absent: the creator's private section). Ignored with parentId or documentId, and in local mode.

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key (recorded so replays converge).

post.description: Adds a property. key defaults to the name (the frontmatter key in a folder). A two-way relation also adds the synced property on the related database (config.relation.reversePropertyId is its id). A uniqueId (config.prefix, e.g. LYD) numbers the existing rows in creation order; its key may not be "id".

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key (recorded so replays converge).

post.description: Returns one window of a view's rows (filtered, sorted, grouped), with the total and group counts. Pass viewId for a saved view, or view for an ad-hoc one (both: view overrides). Properties in filters, sorts and groups are named by id, key or name. Page with window (offset, limit; hasMore says whether rows remain). uniqueId values are numbers (shown as prefix-number, e.g. LYD-12); filters take 12 or "LYD-12".

viewId.description: A saved view's id or name.

today.description: The caller's local date for relative date filters. Default: the server's.

post.description: Creates a row (a document under the database). Values implied by the view's filter and by the group (group/subGroup keys) are filled in, as in Notion; values override them. With templateId, the template's properties and body are copied first. uniqueId properties get the next number unless values gives one (12 or "LYD-12").

patch.description: Sets property values on one or many rows in one step: rowIds with set/unset applies the same values to every row; updates gives each row its own. Values are checked against the property type; unknown select options are added. Relation changes update the two-way side. uniqueId values are positive whole numbers: pass 12 or "LYD-12".

exact.description: Write the values as given: no type checks, no new options, no two-way relation updates. Undo uses it to restore earlier values exactly.

newOptions.description: Options this call adds (recorded by the client so replays mint the same ids).

post.description: Moves rows to the trash (as doc.delete). Relations to them hide until restored.
Copies rows (title, values and body), each right after its original.

ids.description: Client-minted ids for the copies, in order.

post.description: Creates, updates and deletes rows in one step. A row without id is created; with id it is updated (title renames it); delete: true moves it to the trash. values are keyed by property id, frontmatter key or name; relation values are row ids; select values are option names (new names become options); uniqueId values are numbers (pass 12 or "LYD-12"; new rows get the next number). unset clears properties. markdown sets the row's page content.

id.description: An existing row to update or delete.

markdown.description: The row's body; replaces the current one.

uniqueId.description: e.g. "LYD-12"; null without a uniqueId property.

rows.description: One per input row, in order.

post.description: Adds, changes and removes properties in one step. update can rename (name), change the type (values are converted), the frontmatter key or the config (options, relation, number format, formula expression). Removed properties keep their values in the rows.

get.description: The database's row templates (config.templateIds), in order, live ones only. Templates are left out of views, counts and relation pickers; pass one as createRow's templateId.

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key (recorded so replays converge).

post.description: Adds, changes and removes views in one step. config is merged into the view's config (filter, sorts, groupBy, columns, …; properties by id, key or name); see get_database for the current values.

patch.description: Sets the filter applied to every view and the row templates.

delete.summary: Turn a database back into a page
delete.description: Removes the database (schema and views go to the trash with it); the document and its rows stay as ordinary pages. To delete the document itself use doc.delete.

get.description: Returns a database's settings, live properties and views, in order.

put.summary: Replace a database's schema and views
put.description: Applies a whole definition (what fromBase reads from a .base file): properties and views with a known id are updated, new ones created, live ones missing from it deleted. Row values are not touched.

post.description: Creates a document in a workspace, optionally under a parent and with an initial Markdown body. Without afterId/beforeId it is appended as the last child.

teamspaceId.description: Hosted: the teamspace a top-level page goes into (null or absent: the creator's private section). Ignored for child pages, which share their parent's space, and in local mode.

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key. Overrides afterId/beforeId; recorded by clients so replays converge.

post.description: Gives a user, a teamspace's members or everyone in the workspace (principalType workspace, principalId = workspace id) a level on the page and its subpages. Needs full access.

post.summary: Share a page with someone by email
post.description: Members get a grant. Someone with an account who is not a member is added as a guest. Anyone else is emailed an invitation that makes them a guest with this access.

post.summary: Publish a document to a connection
post.description: Creates a publication of a document (and its subpages with `includeSubpages`) to a connection, and queues the first run unless `publishNow` is false. `config` follows the connector's configSchema (connector.list). Owners and admins with edit access to the document.

filter.description: Publish only documents whose property equals this (lists: contains it).

post.description: A restricted page does not inherit access from its parent or its teamspace: only its own grants apply (to it and its subpages). Restricting gives you full access so you keep it.
Creates a view-only public link to the page (and, by default, its unrestricted subpages). The token is returned only once. Needs full access.

post.summary: Leave a note or a comment
post.description: Starts a thread beside a document; the body is not changed and threads are never published. A note is what the next reader should know about the text (why it says this, what it was checked against); a comment needs an answer. `quote` attaches it to a passage of the document; add `prefix` or `suffix` (the text just before or after) when the passage occurs more than once. Without `quote` it is about the whole page.

exact.description: For editors: quote is the document's text already, store it as given.

get.description: The notes and comments left beside a document, oldest first, each with its replies. Open threads only unless `state` says otherwise.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a document and its subtree. Restore it with doc.restore. Deleting a deleted document is a no-op.

get.description: Returns a document's metadata and, unless includeBody is false, its Markdown body, with `threads`: the open notes and comments left beside it, when there are any.
Lists live documents that link to this document.
Lists live documents that link to one block (`[[Note#^blockId]]`) of this document.

patch.description: Replaces the body with markdown, or applies edits in order, all or nothing: replace swaps oldStr for newStr, insertBefore/insertAfter put newStr next to oldStr, prepend/append add newStr as a block at the start/end (also of an empty body). oldStr is matched against the Markdown from fetch_doc and must occur exactly once unless replaceAll; otherwise nothing is written and the error names the edit. expectedVersion makes a stale write a conflict.

get.description: Lists the links in this document (body first, then properties, in document order), each with the live document it resolves to or null.

post.description: Moves a document (and its subtree) under a new parent, or to the top level with parentId null. Without afterId/beforeId it becomes the last child.

sortKey.description: Explicit fractional key. Overrides afterId/beforeId; recorded by clients so replays converge.

patch.description: Merges `set` into the document's properties and removes the keys in `unset`.

post.description: Permanently deletes a document in the trash, its trashed subtree, bodies and outgoing links. Links to it become unresolved. Cannot be undone.
Restores a soft-deleted document and the part of its subtree deleted with it. If its parent is gone it is restored to the top level.

post.summary: Move a page to another teamspace or to Private
post.description: Moves the page and its subpages to the top level of a teamspace you belong to, or of your private section (teamspaceId null). Needs full access to the page.

sortKey.description: Recorded by clients so replays converge.

get.description: Lists live documents whose text mentions this document's title without linking to it.
Lists saved versions of a document's body, newest first.
Returns one saved version of a document's body as Markdown.

post.description: Makes the body read as a saved version again, as a new edit. The body before the restore is kept as a version (`previousVersionId`): restore it to undo.

versionId.description: The version recording the restored body; null when it is recorded later.

version.description: The body's new content version (for expectedVersion).

post.description: Shares a drawing on lydie.co/doodles, replacing the one you shared before. It is shown there once it has been approved; the returned link shows it to you straight away.

strokes.description: Strokes in the 100 × 100 box, each a list of [x, y] points.

url.description: lydie.co/doodles, showing your doodle for the next hour.

get.description: The approved doodles on lydie.co/doodles, newest first. With `yours` (the token in the link doodle.share returns), also the sharer's own doodle, approved or not. No account needed.

image.description: The picture: an SVG URL, or an SVG data: URL for yours.

get.description: Lists sessions that changed a workspace, most recent first.
Lists every operation a session applied, oldest first.

post.description: Reverts every change a session made, newest first, as one undoable step. Changes that later edits by others touched are skipped and reported, as are changes that cannot be undone.
The signed-in account's email must match the invitation.

get.summary: Look up an invitation by its token

post.description: Sends a new link and extends the expiry. The previous link stops working.

delete.description: Its access and refresh tokens stop working at once.

get.description: For the consent page: which app asks, for what, and until when. 404 when the request is unknown, expired or already decided.

post.summary: Approve or deny an OAuth authorization request
post.description: approve: true needs workspaceId (the app is confined to it) and may narrow scopes. Returns where to send the browser: the app's redirect URI with code and state, or with error=access_denied.

get.description: A publication with the state of each published document.

patch.description: Owners and admins with edit access to the document.

filter.description: Publish only documents whose property equals this (lists: contains it).

delete.description: Stops publishing. What was published stays at the destination: run publication.unpublish first to take it down. Owners and admins with edit access to the document.

post.description: Settles a document that changed both in Lydie and at the destination. `overwrite` publishes the Lydie version over the remote edits. `keepRemote` accepts the destination's version as published without changing the document. `pull` merges the remote edits into the document (connectors that can pull) and publishes the result; a merge conflict leaves it diverged. Owners and admins with edit access to the document.

Queues a run that publishes what changed: unchanged documents are skipped (content hash), remote edits are detected and pulled back or shown as a divergence, never overwritten. `force` republishes unchanged documents. `import` first creates a document under the publication's root for everything the destination already has in its place and Lydie has no document for (connectors that can pull, publications with subpages); those files are left as they are until their documents change. `scheduledAt` runs it later. A waiting run absorbs repeated requests. Owners and admins with edit access to the document.

get.description: Runs newest first, with their step log (requests, commits, deliveries, errors).

post.description: Queues a run that takes every published document down at the destination (deletes the file, sets the post back to draft or trashes it, or notifies, per connector). Owners and admins with edit access to the document.

patch.description: Set expiresAt or password to null to remove them.
Changes name, description, icon, visibility or default flag. Teamspace owners and workspace owners/admins only. Changing visibility changes who can read its pages.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the teamspace and moves its pages to the trash.

post.description: Teamspace owners and workspace owners/admins. Guests cannot join teamspaces.

Brings back a deleted teamspace and the pages that were moved to the trash with it. Pages trashed before the teamspace was deleted stay in the trash. Workspace owners and admins, and the teamspace's owners.

patch.summary: Edit a thread or a reply
patch.description: Changes the text of a thread or of one reply. Only its author may.

delete.summary: Delete a thread or a reply
delete.description: Deleting a thread hides its replies too. Undo with thread.restore.

put.description: Attaches a thread to another passage, or to the page as a whole with anchor null. Editors use it to keep a thread on its text while the text is edited.

post.description: Marks a thread as dealt with: an answered comment, a note that no longer applies. It is kept, and resolved: false reopens it.

post.summary: Restore a thread or a reply

id.description: Client-minted id of the reply. Generated when omitted.

post.description: Adds an email to the waitlist for a Lydie cloud account and sends it a confirmation link. No account needed. The answer is the same whether or not the email was already on the list or already has an account. Rate-limited per client address.

get.description: Tells a signed-out app whether to offer creating an account or joining the waitlist. No account needed.

post.description: Creates a workspace with you as its owner and an open, default teamspace called General. With gettingStarted, it also gets a short Getting started page in your private section.

gettingStarted.description: Add a Getting started page, created before the response returns.

patch.description: Changes the name, the slug (the workspace's name in web app URLs, /w/<slug>), or both. The slug stays as it is unless one is given, so links keep working through a rename.

post.description: Lists what happened in a workspace, most recent first: documents created, renamed, moved, edited, deleted; files added; database changes; on a hosted workspace also members, teamspaces, sharing, API tokens and publishing. Repeated changes to the same thing by the same actor within a few minutes are one item with a count. Page with `cursor`.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous page. Pass the same filters.

targetId.description: Only changes to this document, file or database.

search.description: Only items whose title (or the name of the person, teamspace or token they are about) contains this (case-insensitive).

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null at the end.

post.description: Creates a personal API token for one workspace. The secret is returned once; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` to /v1 operation routes or /mcp. It acts as you, limited to this workspace and the given scopes (default: read and write).

get.description: Your live (not revoked, not expired) tokens for a workspace, newest first.
Lists a workspace's attachments, or one document's, newest first.
Your automatic backups of this workspace: how often they run and the zips kept (the export of what you can read, the same files as workspace.export). Only you see them.

put.summary: Turn automatic backups on or off
put.description: off, daily or weekly. The first backup runs within minutes of turning them on. Kept backups stay when you turn them off.

get.description: Lists the direct children of a document (or the top level when parentId is omitted) in order, each with its number of live children. Use it to load a tree level by level.

post.description: Connects a workspace to a destination with a token or generated secret (OAuth: connection.authorize). The credentials are checked with the destination first and stored encrypted; they are never returned, except generated secrets (`revealed`), once. Owners and admins only.

revealed.description: Generated secrets (webhook signing secret). Shown only now.

get.description: The workspace's destination connections (no credentials). Owners and admins only.

post.description: Returns the provider's sign-in URL. After the person approves, the provider returns to the API, which creates the connection (or re-authorises `connectionId`) and redirects to the web app's connection settings with `?connection=<id>` or `?error=`. Owners and admins only.

get.description: Lists the live databases of a workspace (database documents not in the trash).

post.description: Exports every page, database and attachment you can read as a zip of the folder format: Markdown files with frontmatter, a `.base` file per database, attachments and `.lydie/`. Unzipped, it opens as a vault in Lydie's local mode and in Obsidian. The trash is left out. Returns a link to download the zip.

put.description: Sets the picture shown beside the workspace's name: an https URL or an image data: URL (the app saves a doodle as SVG). Null goes back to the generated picture.

post.description: Adds to the workspace's inbox, a top-level page named Inbox that is created when missing. Without a title the text is appended to the inbox as a list item (prefixed with `time`, e.g. 09:41, when given). With a title it becomes a page inside the inbox, with the text as its body and `url` as its `source` property. Needs only the inbox:write scope, so a capture-only token (a web clipper, an automation) cannot read or change anything else. Returns ids only, never content.

time.description: Local time of the capture (HH:mm), shown before an appended item.

created.description: A titled capture made a page of its own.

post.description: Emails an invitation link (valid for 7 days). Inviting an email that already has a pending invitation sends a fresh link. Owners and admins only.

teamspaceIds.description: Teamspaces the invitee joins on accepting (not for guests).

post.description: Same as being removed. The owner must transfer ownership first. Your private pages go to the owner.

delete.description: Removes someone from the workspace, its teamspaces and every page shared with them. Their private pages are transferred to the workspace owner and stay private.

post.description: Owners and admins can change roles. Only the owner can demote an admin. Making someone a guest removes them from every teamspace; they keep pages shared with them directly.

get.description: Apps you allowed to act for you in this workspace through OAuth (MCP clients).
Publications in a workspace the caller can see (view access to the published document), optionally of one document.

Full-text search over titles and bodies. Words are matched as prefixes; all words must match. A title equal to the query comes first. When nothing matches, titles similar to the query (sharing most of its letter trigrams, so typos still find them) are returned instead, without <mark> highlights.

post.description: You become its owner. Guests cannot create teamspaces.

get.description: Open and closed teamspaces, plus private ones you belong to. Workspace owners and admins see all.

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: List deleted teamspaces you could restore instead (admins, teamspace owners).

post.description: Makes another member (not a guest) the owner. You become an admin.

get.description: Lists what is in a workspace's trash, newest first. A document deleted with its subtree is one item; restoring it restores the subtree.

delete.description: Permanently deletes everything in a workspace's trash. Cannot be undone.

get.description: Lists documents depth-first in tree order. With rootId, lists that document's descendants only.
Lists links in live documents whose target does not exist (yet).

sessionId.description: The agent session (one run of work).

targetId.description: The document, attachment or database the change is about; null for a change to the workspace itself (a member, a teamspace, a token), described by `data.subject`.

targetTitle.description: Its title (an attachment's filename) at the time of the latest change.

count.description: How many changes this row stands for.

subject.description: Workspace changes: what the row is about (the person, teamspace, token…).

teamspace.description: teamspace.member*: the teamspace; doc.moved to another space: that space (null: Private).

previousName.description: workspace.renamed, teamspace.renamed: the name before the first rename.

slug.description: workspace.renamed: the new address, when it changed.

role.description: member.*: the role (teamspace.member*: owner or member in the teamspace).

previousRole.description: *.roleChanged: the role before the first change.

level.description: share.*, member.invited to a page: the access level.

previousLevel.description: share.changed: the level before the first change.

previousVisibility.description: teamspace.visibilityChanged: the visibility before the first change.

failed.description: publication.published, .failed: documents that could not be published.

previousTitle.description: doc.renamed: the title before the first rename.

parentId.description: doc.created, doc.moved (latest): the parent; attachment.created: the document.

previousParentId.description: doc.moved: the parent before the first move.

keys.description: doc.propertiesChanged: the property keys that changed (capped).

count.description: doc.deleted, doc.restored, doc.purged: documents affected (subtree included); publication.published, .unpublished: documents published or taken down.

name.description: A person's name, an invitation's email, a token's or connection's name.

ActivityType.description: What an activity row stands for: an event type, or a change to the workspace itself (members, teamspaces, sharing, tokens, publishing).

ActorRef.description: User id, or agent:<app>:<id>:<onBehalfOf>, or system:<id>.

prefix.description: The secret's first characters, to recognise it.

documentId.description: The document it belongs to; null for workspace files.

device.description: From the User-Agent, e.g. "Chrome on macOS".

sourceProperty.description: Set when the link is in a property (a relation value or a [[link]]).

lastError.description: Why the last backup failed; null when it worked.

backups.description: Newest first; the last few are kept.

oldStr.description: The exact text to replace or insert at. Not for prepend/append.

replaceAll.description: Every match of oldStr, not exactly one.

childCount.description: Live children, so a tree can show a disclosure.

account.description: Who the credentials act as at the destination.

Connection.description: A destination account. Credentials are never returned.

fields.description: JSON Schema of the credentials to type in.

available.description: false: OAuth is not configured on this server.

DatabaseOutline.description: A database's properties and views, in order.

key.description: Stored types: the frontmatter key holding the value. Formulas, rollups, createdBy and updatedBy: the formula name in the .base file. Unused for title and created/updated time.

Document.description: Document metadata. The body is not part of it.

version.description: Opaque content version; pass it as expectedVersion.

id.description: Opaque: a snapshot id, or a commit when history is kept in git.

kind.description: auto: the body after a round of edits. before_write: the state before a write that was not recorded (an API write, a restore, a change made while the app was closed). restore: the result of a restore. external: recorded outside Lydie (a git commit by another program).

authors.description: Actor refs of whoever changed the body since the previous version.

label.description: A note that came with the version (git: the commit subject and its author).

hideEmpty.description: Hide groups with no rows (board columns).
Hide groups with no rows (board columns).

inverse.description: Operations that undo it, in the order to run them; null if it cannot be undone.

groupId.description: Operations applied together (one transaction) share a group.

redirectHost.description: Where the app sends you back (host[:port]).

targetRef.description: The link target as written (path or title, without #part).

target.description: The live document it resolves to; null when it resolves to nothing or to the trash.

PrincipalType.description: workspace = everyone in the workspace except guests.

range.description: date: values may carry an end (start/end)

prefix.description: uniqueId: shown before the number ("LYD" → LYD-12)

range.description: date: values may carry an end (start/end)

prefix.description: uniqueId: shown before the number ("LYD" → LYD-12)

range.description: date: values may carry an end (start/end)

prefix.description: uniqueId: shown before the number ("LYD" → LYD-12)

PropertyRef.description: A property's id, frontmatter key or name (case-insensitive).

folder.description: A connected folder: the root document stands for the place itself at the destination (a repository folder) and only its subpages are published.

filter.description: Publish only documents whose property equals this (lists: contains it).

divergence.description: For diverged items: reason, base/ours/theirs (destination format), conflicts, marked text and the pull request.

databaseId.description: The database whose rows this relation points at.

reversePropertyId.description: The synced property on the other database (two-way relations).

databaseId.description: The database whose rows this relation points at.

reversePropertyId.description: The synced property on the other database (two-way relations).

targetPropertyId.description: A property of the related database.
A property of the related database.

RowRef.description: A row's id or unique id ("LYD-12").

snippet.description: Matching excerpt; matches are wrapped in <mark></mark>.

inherited.description: Grants on ancestors that apply here, nearest first, up to a restricted page.

people.description: Everyone who can access the page and their resolved level.

signUp.description: open: anyone can create an account. waitlist: only emails approved on it.

SortKey.description: Fractional index key; siblings sort by (sortKey, id).

anchor.description: null: about the page as a whole.

sessionId.description: The agent session (MCP connection, CLI run) that started it, if any.

ThreadKind.description: note: context for the next reader, kept quietly beside the text. comment: expects an answer.

parentId.description: Where a document goes back to on restore, if still there.

depth.description: 0 for the top level of the listed tree.

snippet.description: Matching excerpt; the mention is wrapped in <mark></mark>.

subKey.description: Set for sub-groups (board swimlanes); null otherwise.

calendarPropertyId.description: calendar: the date property placing rows
calendar: the date property placing rows

hasMore.description: Rows remain after this window (database.query sets it).

group.description: The row's group (null: no value or not grouped).

image.description: The picture: an SVG URL, or an SVG data: URL for yours.

url.description: Where to download the zip: a short-lived signed link on the hosted API, a local file or blob URL in the apps, the file it was saved to on the desktop. null when the person cancelled saving.

expiresAt.description: When `url` stops working; null if it does not.

WorkspaceRole.description: Guests only see pages shared with them.

slug.description: The workspace's name in web app URLs: /w/<slug>.

image.description: Its picture: an image URL or an SVG data: URL. Null: the generated one.

LydieVersion.name: Lydie-Version
LydieVersion.description: API version (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the version pinned on the token.
